item.title: Top 5 Ways to Enable a Virtualenv in a systemd Service Unit
item.description:
Enabling a virtual environment in a systemd service unit can be a critical aspect of deploying Python applications. It allows you to run your application in an isolated environment avoiding the impact of system-wide Python packages and ensuring compatibility. Here are five highly effective methods to achieve this integration:

Method 1: Directly Specify the Python Interpreter
